basic_info.description: Experience the best of city living with this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom, 2-car parking condo at Jackson Towers, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Bay, Golden Gate Bridge, and city skyline. Located in a prime NW corner unit, this home features an open-concept living space filled with natural light, thanks to floor-to-ceiling windows that lead to a cozy balcony perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or sunset views in the evening. The beautifully updated kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and custom cabinetry. The spacious primary bedroom includes a large walk-in closet and a luxurious ensuite bath with double sinks. The second bedroom boasts captivating downtown views, ideal for guests or as a versatile space for remote work. Additional highlights include 2 car-deeded parking spaces, custom window treatments, and convenient window air conditioning units. The professionally managed building offers high-speed elevators and a rooftop deck with incredible views. An incredibly convenient location near shops & world-class dining on Polk St, Union St and Fillmore St plus easy access to public transport and tech shuttles. Seller willing to credit buyer up to 1-year of HOA dues.
